name: the_blemish_hunt
conceit: One AI plate of the whole lamb, studied by code alone -- magnified PIL crops (the flank, the eye) zoom into the same raw pixels, never a second generation pretending to be a closer look. The crop-zoom technique itself works cleanly; the real finding this round was in the SUBJECT, not the mechanism: the rendered animal reads as a mature horned ram, not the young lamb without blemish Exodus 12:5 specifies.

anti: a subject with no real fine physical detail or textured surface to reward close inspection
a beat where the close-up itself needs new information not present in the wide plate -- crop-zoom can only reveal what was already rendered, it cannot add detail

plate_bill.must_contain: a single young lamb standing calmly in profile, full body visible, careful naturalist-study linework, plain aged paper background, soft even lighting, centered, nothing else in frame

motion_slots.earned_by: the device's whole thesis is a static naturalist study examined by crop-zoom alone; no beat here currently needs invented motion.

accuracy_spec: Exodus 12:5 -- a LAMB, male, of the FIRST YEAR: young, small, NO curled horns. A mature ram is a doctrinal/textual miss, not a style variation.

beat_template.hook: the whole lamb, calm, in profile, meant to be studied
beat_template.pivot: the flank, day 12 -- examined for blemish
beat_template.landing: the eye, day 14 -- without blemish, ready

score_shape: a slow, careful, magnifying-glass pulse under each crop-zoom, unhurried and even throughout, no swell until a final beat confirms the animal is without blemish.
